verdict.rationale: SendGrid's core email-sending capabilities (Mail Send API, SMTP relay, sandbox mode, event webhook, inbound parse) are clearly API-accessible per docs [sendgrid-docs-2,15,16,4,17,5,6,7,8]. However, several UI-centric features—domain authentication, dynamic template management, deliverability insights dashboard, and marketing campaigns—are documented under the 'ui' doc paths [sendgrid-docs-9,10,11,26,27,28,29] without corresponding evidence of full API equivalents, suggesting incomplete parity for configuration/analytics tasks. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/docs for domain authentication setup, template CRUD/versioning, deliverability analytics retrieval, and marketing campaign management to prove full UI-API parity.
